channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Fresh row over leader's claim that major council shake-up is 'off'
item.description: Norfolk council leader Kay Mason Billig has come in for fresh criticism after claiming a shake-up to the county's councils is off.

item.title: Bikers go hell for leather against City Hall over risk of meet-up spot being moved
item.description: Norwich City Council is not getting an easy ride over plans to move the motorcycle park near Norwich Market after more than 1,200 people signed a petition against it.

item.title: Riddle deepens over rubbish dumped between traveller site and recycling centre
item.description: Mystery continues to mount over an ever-increasing mound of fly-tipped rubbish, left on land between a traveller site and recycling centre near Norwich.

item.title: Time to enforce more of Norfolk's 20mph speed limits, council leader tells police
item.description: Norfolk County Council's leader Kay Mason Billig has called for police to enforce more of the county's rural 20mph speed limits.

item.title: Patients 'horrified' by dental surgery plan to turn practice into flat
item.description: Patients at Cotman House Dental surgery are still urging Norwich City Council planners to refuse an application to turn their practice into a flat.

item.title: Empty market stall spruced up before hunt for new tenant begins
item.description: Norwich City Council says it is preparing an empty stall on the market, which was previously occupied by Mick's Foams, before it offers the stall to a new tenant.

item.title: Plans for garden storage unit to be transformed into holiday let approved
item.description: Plans to create a one-bedroom holiday let annexe in Halesworth have been approved by East Suffolk Council.

item.title: Actor from hit BBC gangster series to attend sci-fi event on Norfolk coast
item.description: Paul Anderson from Peaky Blinders will be coming to a sci-fi festival on the Norfolk coast this May.

item.title: New figures reveal most crime-hit streets in popular Norfolk resort in 2025
item.description: New figures have revealed the streets with the highest number of recorded crime in Cromer last year and how it is related to the tourist season.

item.title: Tributes paid to trailblazing former Great Yarmouth ship captain
item.description: Tributes have been paid to trailblazing former shipmaster Alison Rawlinson who worked from Great Yarmouth for several years.
